title: “The moment you stop fighting for control… is the moment God shows you what your life was always meant to become.”
paragraphs:
“The moment you stop fighting for control… is the moment God shows you what your life was always meant to become.”
Surrender isn’t losing — it’s letting God finally win for you.

Proverbs 3:5–6 (NIV)
“Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight.”
